sources.entry: GET3D-Nvidia - Generative 3D Textured Shapes from Images. #free

summary.name: GET3D
summary.one_liner: GET3D is an NVIDIA research generative model that produces textured 3D meshes with complex topology, learned from 2D image collections.
use_cases: creating textured meshes for rendering engines
producing cars, chairs, animals or characters as 3d models
summary.what_it_does: GET3D is a generative model that directly outputs explicit textured 3D meshes with complex topology, geometric detail, and high-fidelity textures. It is trained from 2D image collections by combining differentiable surface modeling, differentiable rendering, and 2D GANs. The meshes are meant to be consumed directly by 3D rendering engines and common 3D software without a neural renderer. The page says it can generate cars, chairs, animals, motorbikes, human characters, and buildings. The page is an academic project page with the paper citation (Gao et al., NeurIPS 2022) and a list of related prior works.
notable: Outputs explicit textured meshes usable directly in 3D rendering engines
Trained from 2D image collections using GAN-based training
Builds on DMTet, nvdiffrec, EG3D, and nvdiffrast
Published at NeurIPS 2022 by NVIDIA and University of Toronto authors
caveats: Business or licensing inquiries go through an NVIDIA Research Licensing form, so commercial use is not clearly free
Page does not state software release, code availability, or supported platforms
